# High Contrast Light

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light)

High Contrast Light is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the High Contrast family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `highContrastLight` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { highContrastLight } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-light';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, highContrastLight],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `highContrastLight` | `Extension` |
| `highContrastLightMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#ffffff` |
| Active line | `#ffffda` |
| Selection | `#9fc3fe` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#800080` | bold | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#800080` | bold | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#095959` | - | 8.12:1 | 7.96:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#000000` | - | 21.00:1 | 20.57:1 | 11.71:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#000000` | - | 21.00:1 | 20.57:1 | 11.71:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#8e3003` | - | 8.16:1 | 7.99:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#0000ff` | - | 8.59:1 | 8.42:1 | 4.79:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#0000ff` | - | 8.59:1 | 8.42:1 | 4.79:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#095959` | - | 8.12:1 | 7.96:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#095959` | italic | 8.12:1 | 7.96:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#8e3003` | italic | 8.16:1 | 7.99:1 | 4.55:1 |
| String | `string` | `#0e5d0c` | - | 8.11:1 | 7.94:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#800080` | - | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#8e3003` | - | 8.16:1 | 7.99:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#8e3003` | - | 8.16:1 | 7.99:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#000000` | - | 21.00:1 | 20.57:1 | 11.71:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#4f4f4f` | italic | 8.19:1 | 8.02:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#4f4f4f` | - | 8.19:1 | 8.02:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#800080` | - | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#095959` | - | 8.12:1 | 7.96:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#800080` | bold | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#800080` | italic | 9.42:1 | 9.23:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | `#8e3003` | bold | 8.16:1 | 7.99:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Link | `link` | `#6600cc` | 500, underline | 8.62:1 | 8.44:1 | 4.81:1 |
| URL | `url` | `#0000ff` | underline | 8.59:1 | 8.42:1 | 4.79:1 |
| Inserted | `inserted` | `#0e5d0c` | - | 8.11:1 | 7.94:1 | 4.52:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#000000` | background, active line, selection | 11.71:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#505050` | gutter | 8.06:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#0000ff` | background, active line | 8.42:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#0000ff` | background | 8.59:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `2px solid #095959` | background, active line | 7.96:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#8e3003, 2px solid #000000` | background (fill or outline) | 21.00:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#9fc3fe` | active line | 1.76:1 | Pass |
